title: The discrete Dirac equation is solved exactly by Feynman's checkerboard

statements.text: The 1+1 Dirac equation in light cone coordinates can be solved exactly with the calculus of finite differences, its complex form giving Feynman's checkerboard, a weighted sum over lattice paths, with continuum solutions as limits.

sources.quote: solve them exactly using the classical calculus of finite differences. The complex form yields “Feynman’s Checkerboard”
